card.name: Words leading into 'not known' statements
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'if' after 'it is not known', or 'of' after 'The effect' or 'The safety', in label sentences about missing or uncertain data.

modes.label: After 'not known'
modes.description: The word 'if' right after 'it is not known', introducing an unstudied question.
modes.example: it is not known<< if>> continuous hemodialysis would provide clinical benefit

modes.label: Noun then 'of'
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'effect' or 'safety' at the start of a sentence about a drug's unstudied effect.
modes.example: The safety<< of>> COTELLIC has not been established

modes.label: Subject before 'not available'
modes.description: A noun ending a subject phrase just before a statement that data are not available.
modes.example: with other CNS active<< drugs>> are not available

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning unknown or theoretical, such as 'unknown' and 'theoretically'.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a label says something is unknown or has not been studied.
